newsitem.title: USA: FGIC qualifies seven issues for bond insurance.
newsitem.headline: FGIC qualifies seven issues for bond insurance.

text.p: Financial Guaranty Insurance Co. said Tuesday it qualified for bond insurance the following seven municipal issues scheduled for competitive sale today:
--Maricopa County Community College, Ariz., $124.25 million General Obligations (GOs).
--Burlingame SD, Calif., $6 million school district bonds.
--Carson City, Nev., $15 million public safty GOs.
--Salem, Ore., $18.54 million reveue bonds are a direct purchase. --U.S. Municipal Desk, 212-859-1650
